description: Renovation contractor. On a bungalow re-side we're adding 50 mm semi-rigid mineral wool boards over the existing OSB, strapping and fibre cement siding. We want to leave out the housewrap and let the mineral wool act as the drainage layer, with the board joints just butted together, not taped or lapped.
known_facts: 50 mm mineral wool exterior boards over OSB

missing_info.why: Section A of the variance form

gold.departure: Insulating sheathing used in lieu of a sheathing membrane with joints neither sealed nor lapped, over moisture-sensitive OSB.

should_cite.why: when insulating sheathing can replace the membrane

gold.engineering_reason: Single-family dwelling renovation within the exemption.
